svg.text: AutoVision-RISC-V: Cycle-Accurate Execution Trace & Hazard Timing Diagram
Real 25+ Cycle Instruction Sequence: RAW Data Forwarding (WB → EX), 1-Cycle DSP Multiplication & Non-Restoring Division Freeze (≤ 34 Cycles)
div x5,x4,x1 (NON-RESTORING DIVIDER FSM BUSY - 32 TO 34 CYCLES)
Stall_PC = 1 (Freezes PC & IF/ID register clock enables)
NOP (32 BUBBLE CYCLES INSERTED BY HAZARD UNIT)
At Cycle 4, add depends on x2 from addi. The Hazard Unit asserts
ForwardBE = 2'b10, routing ResultW (20) directly to ALU SrcBE
without inserting pipeline bubbles (0 stall penalty).
At Cycle 6, div x5 initiates the non-restoring shift-subtract
FSM, asserting div_busy = 1 and Stall_PC = 1 for 32 to 34
cycles. PC remains frozen at 0x14, holding addi x6 in IF while
At Cycle 4, mul executes in a single cycle via Artix-7 DSP48E1
hard slices. At Cycle 39, the completed quotient x5=20 is
immediately forwarded via ForwardAE = 2'b10 into addi x6.
